title: Your King Is Not the Problem
setup: Both kings are exposed — yours on e8, Black's on e1 — and Black has a rook on c5 and a bishop on a2 in the game.
hint: Ignore what Black is threatening and count your own checks to the end.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qe4+}} starts it, {{Rg2+}} takes the second rank, and {{Qe1#}} lands. When two kings are both in the open, the hunt belongs entirely to whoever gets to check first.
